manifest.description: A one-line forecast above the composer: measured context use for the open thread, a sparkline of recent completed turns, and the last turn’s change.

manifest.name: Midnight blue
manifest.description: A calm dark palette using T3’s native theme tokens. Turning it off restores your normal appearance.

manifest.name: Quiet paper
manifest.description: A soft light palette with blue controls. Uses T3’s own tokens and restores the original theme when disabled.
manifest.author: Mods for T3 Code
